name: Deluxe Memory Man

dims.source: EHX official spec 5.75 x 4.75 x 2.5 in (ehx.com/products/deluxe-memory-man, UPC 683274010724, verified in data/spec_sheets_staging.json); W=5.75 (left-right) / D=4.75 (front-back) resolved from the orthographic face photo aspect 866x714 px = 1.213 = 5.75/4.75 (staging W/D transposed, see references/ehx-deluxe-memory-man_measurements.md); bare enclosure h=1.68 in measured from calibrated side/back photos (254 px at 150-151 px/in) - published 2.5 in is overall incl. knobs (0.65 in above deck) and feet

enclosure.notes: Flat silver die-cast box, constant deck height in both side views - not sloped (contrast Big Muff Pi). Black field is print, supplied by textures/ehx-deluxe-memory-man-decal.png; sides stay silver.

knobs.note: Photo-derived: BLEND left knob, black puck 0.66 in dia, 0.65 in above deck (ehx body diaScale 0.68 / height 1.05). Row spacing-fit from measured right three, corroborated in back view; provisional to 0.05 in.
Photo-derived: LEVEL knob, same row. OVERLOAD LED sits directly in front of this knob.
Photo-derived: FEEDBACK centre-left knob, same row.
Photo-derived centroid (570.7, 289.2 px) in the face view: CHRS/VIBR knob. Pointer points front-left in the reference (rot 2.35, at the hero drag clamp; single-view, +/-0.15 rad).
Photo-derived centroid (708.1, 291.3 px): DEPTH knob, same row.
Photo-derived centroid (842.9, 291.2 px): DELAY right knob, same row.

led.note: Bypass/status red LED in the MAN wordmark, face red-blob centroid (500.8, 620.0 px). This is the LED the footswitch toggles. The second (OVERLOAD) LED at (-1.35, -0.54) has no spec field - the shared assembler supports one led; the hero page stages it as an extra led() part (see notes).

footswitch.note: Round chrome stomp centred, face bright-chrome centroid (501.1, 743.4 px) -> (0.00, 1.62); corroborated at the front end of both side views.

jacks.note: DIRECT OUT on the left wall. Two views agree to 0.05 in: side-left hole centre -> z +0.03, face left-edge tab -> z -0.02 (references/ehx-deluxe-memory-man_measurements.md).
EFFECT OUT on the left wall, front of DIRECT OUT: side-left -> z +0.81, face tab -> z +0.78.
INPUT on the right wall: side-right (mirrored view) -> z +0.83, face right-edge tab -> z +0.78.

powerJack.note: 24V square socket centred on the back wall, back-view centroid (500.5, 495.1 px) -> x +0.01, y 0.89. Square bezel matches the photographed plate (barrel is 24V on this model; voltage is print only).

notes: EHX Deluxe Memory Man XO (current reissue, UPC 683274010724) hero. Flat silver box 5.75 x 4.75 x 1.68 in bare (2.5 in published overall); all deck parts seat via surfaceAt() on the flat deck - no hardcoded y on knobs/LED/switch. Six knobs in one row (BLEND/LEVEL/FEEDBACK/CHRS-VIBR/DEPTH/DELAY), bypass LED is spec.led. Shared-library gap: the real pedal has a second red OVERLOAD LED at (-1.35, -0.54, face centroid 298.6,420.1 px, side-view corroborated) but spec/assemblePedal support only one led, so the hero page stages an extra led() part at that measured position and keeps it lit; adding a spec-level second LED (e.g. led2 / leds[]) to parts.js + validate.html is the shared fix. Top art: silver ground, black diagonal wedge, DELUXE/MEMORY/MAN wordmarks, diagonal Echo/Chorus/Vibrato and the electro-harmonix script are in textures/ehx-deluxe-memory-man-decal.png (canvas-drawn); knob/edge/24V words are vector textLabels above it. Positions are photo-derived from references/ehx-deluxe-memory-man_measurements.md (face homography + side/back corroboration); left-three knob x are spacing-fit provisional to 0.05 in as flagged there.
